_comment: THE EDITABLE MATCH STRATEGY (teleop, shift-aware). This is the one file to change to re-task the autonomous robot per match / per alliance partner — no code change. Coordinates are BLUE-ORIGIN meters (x toward red, y toward the far sideline); the navigator alliance-flips them and LegalRegion clamps every target into legal space, so you cannot author a coordinate that drives through the hub/tower/trench or out of our zone. 'locations' are named waypoints; 'plans' assign behavior + a route of those names to each match mode. Modes come from ShiftSchedule: OUR_HUB_ACTIVE (transition + our active shifts: shoot+cycle on our side), OUR_HUB_INACTIVE (opponent's shift: harvest deep in the neutral zone, then pre-stage so we arrive home as our hub re-activates), ENDGAME (both hubs active: score-cycle; this robot has no climb). 'returnLeadSeconds' is how early, before our hub re-activates, the harvest plan abandons collecting and stages home. AUTO is intentionally NOT here — the 20s auto runs the PathPlanner .auto picked in the chooser. Schema-validated at load with a safe fallback (see StrategyConfig): an invalid file logs a DriverStation error and the brain degrades to a plain legal score-and-cycle.
